## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One fix is needed before merge: `CRITERION_HINT` now tells users to leave out "shall", but the validator rejects exactly those bullets when the existing `require_shall` option is on.

## Changes
The pull request rewords `CRITERION_HINT` and `BULLET_HINT` in `app/criteria.py`. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make CRITERION_HINT agree with require_shall=True — With `require_shall=True`, a user who follows the hint and writes `- Save the result` is rejected, because `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` (app/criteria.py:7-8). `tests/test_criteria.py:20-21` asserts that rejection. — Deployments with `require_shall: true` show guidance that guarantees validation failure, and the hint gives no way to recover. — Fix: Pick the hint based on `require_shall`, or remove the "without the word shall" clause from the shared hint.
